translations.web: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.
translations.bsb: Outside, the sword will take their children, and inside, terror will strike the young man and the young woman, the infant and the gray-haired man.
translations.kjv: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.
translations.asv: Without shall the sword bereave, And in the chambers terror; It shall destroy both young man and virgin, The suckling with the man of gray hairs.
